headline: The housing decree stalls in Moncloa despite Sumar's pressure to bring it to the Council of Ministers now
summary: Spain's housing decree remains stalled in Moncloa despite pressure from coalition partner Sumar to bring it to the Council of Ministers. Government sources said the votes are not yet secured.
why: Spain's housing legislation shapes rental and property market rules that affect real estate investors and developers.
